doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revisions to Second Quarter and Full-Year Business Performance Forecasts for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027, and Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2027年３月期第２四半期業績予想の修正及び通期業績予想の修正並びに期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: グループの業績が当初予想を上回って推移したことを踏まえ、通期業績予想を上方修正したため

summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 112 yen from 92 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, with interim dividend held at 45 yen and year-end dividend increased to 67 yen from 47 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year profit forecast.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の通期配当を1株当たり92円から112円に増配。中間配当は45円据え置き、期末配当を47円から67円に引き上げ。通期業績予想の上方修正に伴う。

doc_title_en: Notice of Implementation of 10th Anniversary Listing Commemorative Dividend

key_facts.reason_jp: 上場10周年記念、株主への感謝と企業成長への決意

summary_en: 92 yen/share FY3/27 (82 yen ordinary + 10 yen commemorative). Interim 45 yen (35 ordinary + 10 commemorative), year-end 47 yen ordinary. Prior year FY3/26: 77 yen/share total.
summary_jp: FY3/27年間配当92円/株（普通82円+記念10円）。中間配当45円（普通35円+記念10円）、期末配当47円。前年度FY3/26は77円/株。
